properties.name: WHAT WORKED (hxm_program, 2026-09-28, reflow2 0.73.0): when an operator closed a stale check on operations evidence, drawing INVALIDATES from the later fix, instead of flipping the check to passing, left it saying exactly what is true: the last run failed, a repair postdates it, a re-run is owed
properties.statement:
Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (the hxm_program hub, 2026-09-28): the owner closed an end-to-end check (a run reaching the facility's data service) on operations evidence ("in operations, no issues"). "Drawing INVALIDATES from the 09-17 fix, instead of flipping the verdict to `passing`, left the check saying exactly what is true: its last run failed, a repair postdates it, and a re-run is owed. `loop_status` read it back that way. This is the right semantics, and it is rare."
What must not regress: invalidates never moves a verdict, and loop_status and where-am-i read a failing check with a later repair as "re-run owed", not as failing and not as passing.
THE SAME REPORT NAMES THE COST OF THE SAME SEMANTICS (F-32, triaged separately): with no grade for operator-attested evidence, this check stays in loop_status's attention indefinitely, on a system everyone agrees works.
